description: Phase 8 release gate record. A gate is 'verified' only with evidence that exists in this repository or a linked record; never flip from CI results alone, and never mark a staging or production gate verified from a local test. rolloutMode stays 'shadow' and releaseAuthorized false until every gate is verified and the owner signs off. Each gate records status, evidence, the verification run and its result, the commit the evidence applies to, and the remaining blockers.

gates.evidence: Create Only writes are denied by default at four server layers (global guard, canonical tenant-boundary check, per-route createOnlyVerifiedCreate guard, offline sync apply handlers). All 24 Phase 1 create candidates were reviewed handler-by-handler; 13 signatures are verified with request guards and 11 kept denied with reasons in docs/permissions-control-center-phase3-route-review.md. The allowlist was not widened in the V2 completion work. Evidence: tests/access-control-v2-create-only-activation.test.ts (every manifest write) and tests/access-control-v2-create-only-http.test.ts (1,100+ routes over HTTP on PostgreSQL, unchanged fingerprints).
gates.verification: npx vitest run tests/access-control-v2-create-only-activation.test.ts tests/access-control-v2-create-only-http.test.ts on PostgreSQL 16: pass (2026-11-07, branch claude/modest-cerf-ftyp48).
gates.required: Review and enforce every eligible business-write handler across ERP, Factory, POS and Properties; Phase 3 incomplete

gates.verification: npx tsx scripts/permissions/audit-frontend-page-catalog.ts: 0 failures over 94 pages / 216 routes; 9 pages verified read-only by import-graph scan; tests/access-control-v2-frontend-page-catalog.test.ts, tests/ui/read-only-role-route-gate.test.tsx and client/src/lib/permissionRevalidation.test.ts pass.
gates.progress: Shared page catalog (shared/permissionPageCatalog.ts) covers ERP, Factory, POS/Retail, Properties and Supplier Partner. Pages that change existing records are closed to View Only and Create Only with an explanation; voucher and POS edit links open the read-only voucher view; unverified create pages are closed to Create Only; Create Master Data offers Create Only only the verified supplier and stock item forms. In-page gating covers Accounts, Containers, Closing stock summary, Customers, Suppliers, Stock Items, Daybook, GIT containers, Factory containers and daybook, pressing, rentals and retail products. Access refreshes across tabs on any permission refusal. Report: docs/permissions-v2-frontend-page-audit.md.
blockers: 25 catalogued pages still show some change controls to View Only/Create Only and rely on the server refusal plus the client request guard message (listed as 'Server and request guard only' in docs/permissions-v2-frontend-page-audit.md).
Browser verification on desktop and mobile, light and dark, English/Arabic/French for the new notice has not been run on a deployed build.
gates.required: All role-sensitive controls integrated and verified against existing backend guards; Phase 6 incomplete
